Build 1 remained running after attempt-0 expiry with no runner and no local attempt-0 nack. No manual retry, follow-up or Cursor request occurred.

Anthropic re-offered the same session as signed attempt 1 at 22:00:04.885238640 UTC, with fresh iat 22:00:04 and exp 22:05:04. At 22:00:05.079208970 the feature branch detected the still-running START build, chose terminal current-attempt failure and did not create a second START. Relay logged an applied non-retryable nack for attempt 1 at 22:00:05.228257528; no attempt-0 nack appeared in the private trial segment. Coder marked START build 1 canceled_at at 22:00:05.323950 and terminal failed at 22:00:05.796797. Coder build 2 was solely the DELETE transition, which finished succeeded at 22:00:21.348458. The sole workspace was absent by the 22:00:25.211489 status poll. The monitor's maximum simultaneous QA workspace count was one over 143 samples with no errors.

Claude's browser showed Failed after 2 attempts by an observation between 22:00:48.731 and 22:00:56.911 UTC. The first failed attempt is consistent with the provider lease expiry; the second with the terminal attempt-1 nack. The exact UI failure transition time is unknown. A loading indicator persisted, without establishing a separate defect. UI screenshots are attached only in the private tester chat, not committed to this public repository. Raw work orders, account claims, full Relay and Coder build logs, and the unredacted status monitor remain private.

The initial F1c case revision 4fa28e3 incorrectly called the expected cleanup DELETE build 2 a forbidden second build; QA main correction af0596f distinguishes DELETE from a second START. Both suite revisions are in the run manifest. The original safe mode-0600 QA config and clean-main launcher were restored byte-for-byte, the dedicated QA Relay restarted, both labeled pool-health gauges returned one, and no steven QA template workspace remained at the final read-only check. The QA template retains a zero-second delay default. No production or shared dogfood Relay was changed.
